name: @asifhussain/prose-editor
description: A self-contained, framework-free rich-text editor toolbar and extension system for TipTap/ProseMirror, whose defining guarantee is that nothing typable can be lost on save.

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:standalone
scripts._comment_prepare: npm runs `prepare` after installing a workspace/link dependency, which `prepack` (pack/publish only) does not cover. Without it a FRESH CLONE has no dist/ — it is gitignored — so every import of this package fails: two site test files and five SSR Studio routes 500'd in CI on 2026-08-01 for exactly this reason, invisible until the install step was fixed and the gates ran for the first time in five days. See RCA-009.
